sentences.text: This ancient sawfish had front teeth with tall peaks, a feature that set it apart from other members of its group.
It is a cartilaginous fish belonging to the family Sclerorhynchidae.
Scientists have found sixteen separate fossil occurrences of this creature.
The genus was first named by Arambourg in 1940.
Only one species, Ctenopristis nougareti, is known to exist within this genus.
These animals lived from the Santonian to the Danian stages, between 85.7 and 61.66 million years ago.
Their remains are found in Maastrichtian rocks in Jordan.
